description: Run multiple Reddit scraping modes (subreddit, comments, profile) in a single execution. Pro adds advanced filters and recordType tagging.

authorFilter.description: Only emit records by this author (case-insensitive substring match).
authorFilter.title: Author filter (substring)

expandThreads.description: Click 'load more comments' buttons to expand collapsed threads.
expandThreads.title: Expand comment threads

keywordFilter.description: Only emit records whose title/content/text contains this substring (case-insensitive).
keywordFilter.title: Keyword filter (substring)

maxAgeDays.description: Drop records older than N days.
maxAgeDays.title: Max age in days (filter)

maxComments.description: Max comments per post (in comments mode).
maxComments.title: Max comments

maxDepth.description: (Comments mode) Drop comments deeper than N levels.
maxDepth.title: Max comment depth

maxPosts.description: Max posts per subreddit or profile.
maxPosts.title: Max posts

minScore.description: Drop records with score below this. Applies to posts and comments alike.
minScore.title: Min score (filter)

mode.description: Single mode (back-compat). Use `modes` for running multiple modes in one run.
mode.title: Scraping mode (single)

modes.description: Run multiple modes in a single execution (e.g. `["subreddit", "profile"]`). When set, overrides the single `mode` field.
modes.title: Modes (multiple, Pro)

section.description: Which profile section to scrape in profile mode.
section.title: Profile section

sort.description: How to sort posts on the listing.
sort.title: Sort posts by

subreddits.description: List of subreddit names without `r/` prefix.
subreddits.title: Subreddit names (for subreddit mode)

usernames.description: Reddit usernames. Accepts plain, `u/spez`, or full URLs.
usernames.title: Usernames (for profile mode)
